headline_2026_08_09: G5 did NOT establish that the HOLB probe's observer effect exceeds 3%, and did NOT establish that it is within 3%. UNDETERMINED: 0/72 arm x response-var cells show a statistically supported |effect| > 3% (min unadjusted p_exceed = 0.138, Holm-adjusted min p = 1.000 in all three jobs); 29/72 cells prove equivalence at +-3% by TOST; the remaining 43/72 are underpowered. At n=5 the paired-t TOST cannot fire at all once the rep-to-rep SD exceeds 3.147%, which 35/72 cells do -- median TOST power at true gap 0 given each cell's own SD is 0.286. The stored 'G5=False' records the failure of a null-acceptance conjunction, not demonstrated probe harm.
